_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: two facts and one step (a sister's daughter); 2: brothers and sisters found from a shared parent, then one step; 3: a long 'the son of the daughter of…' description, or two families joined by a marriage; 4: signs that stand for relations, or a statement to find true or false from them, or a whole family to build first. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
